codeGrantText: Authorize rule kr-molit-bounded-icao@2.0.0-draft policy-sha256:37e01b54bcf28f4d25a5e49b04f5905d3b107de132e4d4b5d9da062ba7024350 scope-sha256:ca29502a69df9e8283fbdfddd0022be6988054336caacdb57f1b2076b555e413 executor-sha256:78d250aa23292eb9ab4d9bc39cc9aa9acb6a2369ab8890a759de4ea6e21dc7af. Permit bounded ICAO code candidate review only after independent physical identity admission by the exact identity rule. Recompute original AIP, NOTAM, SUP and checklist facts for the exact window. New evidence versions need fresh fact replay; mutation under an old hash rejects. No inherited v1/Indian grant, IATA, new identity creation, expanded dates, published corrections, test authority or direct main writes. Batch candidate PR only; human merge required.
identityGrantText: Authorize rule official-aip-stable-physical-identity@0.1.0-draft policy-sha256:1de275a7baeb1b1216190d7f5e1b2b09ebe7449e5a117ad1f98af9247efd80ee scope-sha256:597ddbc5afeb66df29bf7dcb405846e9ac912ae4bfa93bfd2b71c24a6c8b4e65 executor-sha256:78d250aa23292eb9ab4d9bc39cc9aa9acb6a2369ab8890a759de4ea6e21dc7af. Permit automatic physical-site UUID allocation for all future qualifying low-risk airports in this country/issuer scope, without per-airport approval. Require original replay, independent operator site/address evidence, complete edition and competition checks. No code/name validity, relocation, correction, test authority, or direct main writes. Candidate PR only; human merge required.
